thin-provision.name: Thin Provision
thin-provision.title: Thin provisioning recommendation
thin-provision.description:
To optimize storage efficiency and cost-effectiveness, configure thin provisioning for your FSx ONTAP volumes and LUNs
If Not Configured Properly:
- Over-provisioning risks: Without thin provisioning, storage is allocated upfront, leading to inefficient use and higher costs due to over-provisioning.
- Increased storage costs: Static allocation results in paying for unused capacity, increasing expenses.
- Limited scalability: Lack of dynamic allocation hampers scalability and flexibility, impacting performance.
- Inefficient space utilization: Without space reclamation, deleted data occupies space, reducing efficiency.

autosize.name: Autosize
autosize.title: Autosize recommendation
autosize.description:
To optimize storage efficiency and cost-effectiveness, turn on autosize to automatically increase the size of a volume when it nears full capacity, thus preventing a volume from running out of space and becoming read-only, which can disrupt operations.
Lack of autosize requires manual monitoring and intervention to manage volume sizes, increasing administrative overhead and the possibility of errors.

autosize-mode.name: Autosize Mode
autosize-mode.title: Autosize mode recommendation
autosize-mode.description: Set autosize mode to "grow" to automatically increase volume size when it gets full. If autosize is off, you must monitor and resize volumes manually, which takes more time and increases the risk of mistakes.

snapshot-copy-reserve.name: Snapshot Copy Reserve
snapshot-copy-reserve.title: Snapshot copy reserve recommendation
snapshot-copy-reserve.description: Set the snapshot copy reserve to 0% to use more storage for active file data and reduce costs.

snapshot-autodelete.name: Snapshot Autodelete
snapshot-autodelete.title: Snapshot autodelete recommendation
snapshot-autodelete.description: Turn on automatic snapshot deletion to remove older snapshots when space runs low, so snapshots do not use space needed for user data.

space-mgmt-try-first.name: Space Mgmt Try First
space-mgmt-try-first.title: Space management try first recommendation
space-mgmt-try-first.description: When space runs low, try expanding the volume before deleting snapshot copies. This helps prevent "volume full" errors, reduces write failures and app interruptions, and keeps snapshot recovery points for easier, stronger recovery while managing capacity.

tiering-tco-optimization.name: Cold data tiering
tiering-tco-optimization.title: Cold data tiering recommendation
tiering-tco-optimization.description:
For optimal database performance and cost efficiency, Workload Factory recommends using the snapshot-only tiering policy, which moves only snapshot data to the capacity tier while keeping active data on the SSD tier.
This approach preserves low-latency performance for SQL workloads while reducing storage costs.
Workload Factory recommends tiering snapshot data after a 7-day cooling period.

mpio-enabled.name: Mpio Enabled
mpio-enabled.title: Multipath I/O recommendation
mpio-enabled.description: To ensure optimal uptime and data access consistency for MSSQL databases on EC2 with underlying LUNs provisioned in FSx for ONTAP, it is recommended to enable and configure Multipath I/O (MPIO). MPIO provides multiple paths to FSx for ONTAP, enhancing both resiliency and performance. This best practice protects against potential data loss or downtime by maintaining data access even if a component fails.

mpio-iscsi-count.name: Mpio Iscsi Count
mpio-iscsi-count.title: MPIO iSCSI session count recommendation
mpio-iscsi-count.description: For SQL Server on FSx for ONTAP iSCSI LUNs, use five multipath I/O (MPIO) sessions per target interface. This balances traffic across paths and improves redundancy, throughput, and failover.

mpio-timeout.name: Mpio Timeout
mpio-timeout.title: MPIO timeout recommendation
mpio-timeout.description: Configure the Microsoft Multipath I/O (MPIO) timeout setting on the host to 60 seconds to ensure connectivity and stability during FSx for ONTAP failovers. The 60-second setting prevents disk disconnections, application errors, and potential data loss caused by insufficient timeout settings.

ntfs-allocation-unit-size.name: Ntfs Allocation Unit Size
ntfs-allocation-unit-size.title: NTFS allocation unit size recommendation
ntfs-allocation-unit-size.description: Set NTFS allocation unit size to 64K to better utilize disk space, reduce fragmentation, and improve file read/write performance. Failure to configure this properly may lead to inefficient disk usage and degraded performance.

mpio-load-balance-policy.name: Mpio Load Balance Policy
mpio-load-balance-policy.title: MPIO load balance policy recommendation
mpio-load-balance-policy.description: To ensure optimal uptime and data access consistency for MSSQL databases on EC2 with underlying LUNs provisioned in FSx for ONTAP, it is recommended to enable and configure Multipath I/O (MPIO). MPIO provides multiple paths to FSx for ONTAP, enhancing both resiliency and performance. This best practice protects against potential data loss or downtime by maintaining data access even if a component fails.

compute-rightsizing.name: Compute Rightsizing
compute-rightsizing.title: Compute rightsizing recommendation
compute-rightsizing.description: Your current EC2 instance is not optimally sized for your SQL Server workload. Workload Factory recommends rightsizing your instance to reduce costs while maintaining performance. Click Optimize to view cost comparison between current and recommended instance types to understand potential savings. Rightsizing ensures you're not over-provisioning resources and paying for unused capacity.

descriptionRssConfig.first: Accurate configuration of receive side scaling (RSS) is essential for optimal network performance in Microsoft SQL Server instances. RSS distributes network processing across multiple processors, preventing bottlenecks and enhancing system performance.
points: Disable TCP Offloading Features: Ensure all TCP offloading features are disabled.
Number of Receive Queues: Set to 8 if vCPUs > 8. Set to the number of vCPUs if vCPUs ≤ 8.
descriptionRssConfig.last: Following these settings will improve the performance and reliability of your Microsoft SQL Server instances. We suggest that you test the recommended settings to determine performance improvements before making changes to your production environment.

mtu-alignment.name: Mtu Alignment
mtu-alignment.title: MTU alignment recommendation
mtu-alignment.description: Workload Factory recommends aligning EC2 instance Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) settings with your FSx for ONTAP file system to prevent network fragmentation and optimize SQL Server performance. Fixing MTU misalignment ensures consistent MTU configuration across all nodes and network paths, preventing packet fragmentation and improving throughput.

host-os-patch.name: Host Os Patch
host-os-patch.title: Operating system patch recommendation
host-os-patch.description: Whenever possible, apply the latest patches to ensure security and stability. Applying the latest patch helps protect your SQL Server databases from vulnerabilities and significantly improves overall system reliability. Critical security patches address known vulnerabilities that could be exploited by attackers.

sql-license.name: Sql License
sql-license.title: License recommendation

descriptionList.title: Not optimized:
descriptionList.description: The SQL Server license assessment is at the host level. A license is considered "not optimized" when Workload Factory detects that any instance running on the host is not using the Enterprise license features you're paying for. An unoptimized license might result in unnecessary costs.

descriptionList.title: Optimized:
descriptionList.description: A license is considered "optimized" when every instance on the host that uses an Enterprise license uses Enterprise features, or when the commercial software license for your databases meets your performance requirements.

sql-license.info: The SQL Server license assessment is at the host level. If any instance running on the host is not using the Enterprise license features, the license is considered not optimized.

mssql-patch.name: Mssql Patch
mssql-patch.title: Microsoft SQL Server patch recommendation
mssql-patch.description: Whenever possible, apply the latest patches to ensure security and stability. Applying the latest patch helps protect your SQL Server databases from vulnerabilities and significantly improves overall system reliability. Critical and important security patches should be applied promptly to protect against known vulnerabilities.

descriptionRssConfig.first: Set the Maximum Degree of Parallelism (MAXDOP) to optimize query performance by balancing parallel processing. Accurate MAXDOP configuration enhances performance and efficiency. Setting MAXDOP to 4, 8, or 16 generally provides the best results in most use cases. We recommend that you test your workload and monitor for any parallelism-related wait types such as CXPACKET.

snapshot-policy.name: Snapshot policy
snapshot-policy.title: Snapshot policy recommendation
snapshot-policy.description: Local snapshots allow you to create instantaneous capacity efficient point-in-time images of your SQL Server data volumes. Use local snapshots as an additional backup mechanism for quick restores or for testing. Enabling snapshot policies ensures regular backup protection for your database volumes.

crr.name: Crr
crr.title: Cross-region replication recommendation
crr.description: Workload Factory recommends enabling Cross-Region Replication (CRR) for your FSx for ONTAP filesystems serving SQL Server. CRR ensures that your data is replicated to another AWS region, providing enhanced data durability and availability. It is recommended to configure CRR for disaster recovery and compliance requirements.

shared-storage.name: Shared Storage
shared-storage.title: Shared storage recommendation
shared-storage.description: All shared disks (iSCSI LUNs) must be accessible by both nodes in the FCI deployment model to allow failover.

drive-letter.name: Drive Letter
drive-letter.title: Drive letter recommendation
drive-letter.description: Workload Factory recommends using consistent drive letter assignments across all nodes in a SQL Server high availability configuration. Consistent drive letters simplify management and ensure proper failover behavior.

cluster-quorum.name: Cluster Quorum
cluster-quorum.title: Cluster quorum recommendation
cluster-quorum.description: For SQL Server Failover Cluster Instances, Workload Factory recommends properly configuring the cluster quorum to ensure cluster health and proper failover behavior. The quorum configuration determines how many node failures the cluster can sustain.

heartbeat-settings.name: Heartbeat Settings
heartbeat-settings.title: Heartbeat settings recommendation
heartbeat-settings.description: Workload Factory recommends configuring appropriate heartbeat settings for SQL Server high availability clusters. Proper heartbeat configuration prevents unnecessary failovers while ensuring timely detection of actual failures.

sql-server-service.name: SQL Server Service
sql-server-service.title: SQL Server service recommendation
sql-server-service.description: Workload Factory recommends ensuring SQL Server services are properly configured for high availability scenarios. This includes appropriate service account permissions, startup types, and dependencies to ensure reliable operation.

os-type.name: OS Type
os-type.title: OS type recommendation
os-type.description: ONTAP LUN os type value shall match the operating system partitioning scheme to achieve I/O alignment. Incorrect configuration may result in suboptimal performance.

block-device-space-management.name: Block device space management
block-device-space-management.title: Block device space management recommendation
block-device-space-management.description:
Workload Factory recommends configuring block device space settings for LUNs used by Microsoft SQL server instances to prevent write failures and improve space efficiency on FSx for ONTAP. This configuration applies the recommended combination of settings for thin‑provisioned volumes:
 Space reservation: enabled — reserves enough space in the volume so writes to the LUN don’t fail. 
 Space allocation: enabled — allows FSx for ONTAP to notify the EC2 host when a volume is full and supports automatic space reclamation when the database deletes data. 
 Fractional reserve: disabled — avoids unnecessary overwrite reservation, optimizing space utilization and cost effectiveness for thin provisioning.Together, these settings help ensure predictable database behavior while minimizing wasted capacity.

data-files-location.name: Data Files Location
data-files-location.title: Data files (.mdf) placement recommendation
data-files-location.description:
Separating data and log files onto different drives improves performance by allowing simultaneous I/O activity, independent backup schedules, and improved restore functionality.
We recommend separating data and log LUN paths into different volumes for smaller databases.
This separation is required when there is more than one large database (> 500 GiB).

log-files-location.name: Log Files Location
log-files-location.title: Log files (.ldf) placement recommendation
log-files-location.description:
Separating data and log files onto different drives improves performance by allowing simultaneous I/O activity, independent backup schedules, and improved restore functionality.
We recommend separating data and log LUN paths into different volumes for smaller databases.
This separation is required when there is more than one large database (> 500 GiB).

tempdb-files-location.name: TempDB Files Location
tempdb-files-location.title: TempDB placement recommendation
tempdb-files-location.description: Separating TempDB files onto dedicated drives improves performance by isolating temporary data operations from user database I/O. We recommend placing TempDB on separate volumes with fast storage to enhance SQL Server performance.

clone-management.name: Clone Management
clone-management.title: Clone management recommendation
clone-management.description:
Old clones can incur significant costs.
Consider deleting or refreshing these clones to optimize your storage expenses.

storage-efficiencies.name: Storage Efficiencies
storage-efficiencies.title: Storage efficiencies recommendation
storage-efficiencies.description: Workload Factory recommends enabling storage efficiencies—deduplication, adaptive compression, and compaction—on volumes used by Microsoft SQL Server to reduce storage footprint, lower costs, and optimize resource utilization while maintaining performance.

snapcenter-snapshot.name: SnapCenter snapshot
snapcenter-snapshot.title: SnapCenter snapshot recommendation
snapcenter-snapshot.description: Use application-consistent snapshots with NetApp SnapCenter to take accurate, reliable snapshots of your volume data at a specific moment in time. This keeps your apps running smoothly and your data safe. SnapCenter makes backups easier and helps you restore data quickly and correctly, reducing downtime and protecting your most important workloads.

log-drive-size.name: Log Drive Size
log-drive-size.title: Log drive size recommendation
log-drive-size.description:
Ensure accurate sizing and regular monitoring of the SQL Server log drive to prevent issues such as transaction rollbacks, database unavailability, data corruption, and performance degradation caused by a full log drive.
An additional 20% buffer is required if the drive is hosting a primary replica of Always On Availability Group.

headroom.name: File system headroom
headroom.title: File system headroom sizing recommendation
headroom.description: Workload Factory recommends provisioning file system capacity as 1.35 times of total size of provisioned volume to optimize storage performance.

tempdb-drive-size.name: TempDB Drive Size
tempdb-drive-size.title: TempDB drive size recommendation
tempdb-drive-size.description: Ensure accurate sizing and regular monitoring of the SQL Server TempDB to well-architect performance and maintain overall stability.
